decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line builds directly on the firm's core natural skincare know-how and in-house development, it has a dedicated web page, and the firm can readily interpret and improve on early results, so it is kept.

The hyaluronic acid serum is close to the established facial care offer and fits the firm's integrated formulation capabilities, so management can assimilate market feedback and keep refining it rather than drop it.
A cleansing milk is a basic complement to the firm's existing facial care range and relies on related knowledge it already holds, so it carries low risk and is likely kept.
